description: How tall a nightstand should be for a mattress (level with its top to 2 inches above; 3 inches either way still works), the typical width for the bed size, depth, the gap to leave, and the widest one that fits beside the bed on a given wall. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

top.description: Floor to the top of the mattress, topper included, in inches.

wall.description: Width of the wall behind the bed, in feet. Optional: leave it out to skip the side-space check.

name: nightstand_size
title: Nightstand size calculator
